prompt.text: Your print job is still on the printer: a {{PRINTOUT}} with customer data. A screen is still unlocked, and there's a password on a sticky note.

setup.speaker: Narrator
setup.text: That's the shift. Before you head for the elevator, take one last look around. Your print job never got picked up.

choices.label: Head out. It'll keep till morning
choices.bark: Printouts, open screen, sticky note. All still out.
choices.report: You left customer printouts, an unlocked screen and a password note out overnight.
choices.consequence_text: You left it all out. The night crew walks right past the printer, and the screen is still open.
choices.debrief_text: Customer data on the printer, an open screen, a password on a sticky note. Anyone walking the floor gets all three. Shred the paper, lock the screen, lose the note.

choices.label: Take the printouts home to finish
choices.bark: Customer data went home in your bag.
choices.report: You took printed customer data out of the building.
choices.consequence_text: The printouts went home in your bag. Customer data, off the premises.
choices.debrief_text: Paper with customer data stays in the building. A bag left on a train is a breach. When you're done with it, it goes in the locked shred bin.

choices.label: Lock the screen and go
choices.bark: Screen locked. Paper and note still out.
choices.report: You locked the screen but left customer printouts and a password note out.
choices.consequence_text: Screen locked. The printouts and the sticky note are still out.
choices.debrief_text: Locking the screen is half the job. The paper goes in the shred bin. The password comes off the monitor and into the password manager.

choices.label: Shred the printouts, lock the screen, pull the note
choices.report: Customer printouts went in the locked shred bin, the screen was locked, and the password note was removed.
choices.consequence_text: Printouts shredded. Screen locked. The note is gone.
choices.debrief_text: Clean desk. Confidential paper goes in the locked shred bin, never the recycling. Lock your screen every time you stand up. Passwords live in the password manager, not on a sticky note.
